name: BaseLifeCyclePage
desc:
A professional, unified page wrapper that handles lifecycle management
and ViewModel state listening, delegating UI structure to BaseScaffoldPage.

name: active
desc: Visibility flag for Tab/Page switching inside the same route.

name: canPop
desc: Whether the page can be popped. If null, it depends on the loading state.

name: lifecycle
desc: Optional UI-layer lifecycle listener.

name: loadingTimeout
desc: Maximum duration a loading state can persist before being forcibly cleared.

name: onEffect
desc: Optional callback to handle custom UI effects.

name: onEmpty
desc: A widget to display when the page is in an empty state.

name: onInterceptBack
desc:
Custom logic to execute when back is intercepted (e.g., custom confirmation dialogs).
If null, default behavior is to cancel requests and hide loading.

name: onLoading
desc:
A widget to display when the page is in a loading state (e.g., a Skeleton screen).
If provided, it will automatically replace the body when the page is loading.

name: useGradientBackground
desc: Whether to use the gradient background decoration for the Scaffold body.

name: useScaffold
desc:
Whether to wrap the content in a BaseScaffoldPage.
Set to false when using this as a sub-page/tab within another page.

name: useVisibilityDetector
desc:
Whether to enable viewport visibility detection (onViewVisible/onViewInVisible).
Disable this for simple static pages to improve performance.

name: viewModel
desc: Explicitly provided ViewModel instance.

name: BaseMaterialApp
desc:
A customized MaterialApp that automatically integrates the Core framework's
navigation system (AppNav) and Zone-based performance tracking.
Use this as a drop-in replacement for MaterialApp to gain framework benefits.

name: navigatorKey
desc: Custom navigator key. If null, uses AppNavConfig.navigatorKey by default.

name: onGenerateRoute
desc: Custom route generator. If null, uses AppNav.onGenerateRoute by default.

name: BaseProvider
desc:
Base interface for all architecture providers.
Establishes a type-safe relationship between an effect E and its executor.

name: canHandle
desc:
Checks if this provider can handle the given effect.
Uses 'is' check which is obfuscation-safe and supports inheritance.

name: handle
desc:
Polymorphic entry point to process an effect.
Automatically casts the effect to its concrete type E.

name: handleEffect
desc:
Concrete logic to process the specific effect E.
To be implemented by the shared layer providers.

name: ProviderRegistry
desc: A central registry for managing global provider implementations and effect routing.

name: handle
desc:
Dispatches an effect to its registered provider.
Iterates through providers and uses explicit type checking for robustness.
Returns true if a handler was found and the effect was processed.

name: init
desc: Registers a list of global provider implementations.

Utility class for FlutterSecureStorage to handle sensitive data encryption.
